title: Use a real button
summary: A button already knows how to work with a keyboard.
introduction: A button already knows how to work with a keyboard. Your task: Reach the button with Tab and activate it with Space.
learningObjectives: Reach the button with Tab and activate it with Space.
Explain the example for use a real button

blocks.text: A button already knows how to work with a keyboard. A plain div does not become a button just because it looks like one.

Try runnable HTML here with a keyboard as well as a mouse. A screen reader is a tool that reads page information aloud. Test real pages with people and tools; one automated check cannot prove everything works.
Read the code step by step

items: `textContent` reads or replaces plain text inside an element. It does not interpret the supplied words as HTML.

blocks.text: The control works with a click, Enter or Space when focused.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not replace a button with a clickable div unless you also rebuild all the button behaviour. Native HTML is simpler.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Reach the button with Tab and activate it with Space.
